verdict.rationale: Segment documents Reverse ETL, which extracts warehouse data using a user-provided query and syncs it to third-party destinations, so activation without re-collection is directly covered. The docs describe audiences only as built from tracking events, traits, and computed traits, not from warehouse tables. Warehouse data appears only in a marketing line about unifying it into profiles. Missing for 10: documented warehouse-native audience building on existing tables, detail on model definition beyond a query, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can run warehouse-native: define models and audiences on tables already in my warehouse and activate them without re-collecting the data (reverse ETL)

citations.quote: Reverse ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) extracts data from a warehouse using a query you provide and syncs this warehouse data to your third party destinations.
Unify events and warehouse data into governed, identity‑resolved profiles
